tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; year_id uuid; code varchar(40); name varchar(160); starts_on date; ends_on date
tables.responsibility: Owned by year; no overlapping intervals; all within year.
tables.constraints: FK(scope,year_id); UNIQUE(scope,year_id,code); CHECK starts_on<ends_on; index(scope,year_id,starts_on)

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; code varchar(40); name varchar(160); starts_on date; ends_on date; status DRAFT/OPEN/CLOSED; version int
tables.responsibility: Half-open year; terms are editable only while DRAFT. Multiple open years permitted if dates/business selection are explicit.
tables.constraints: UNIQUE(scope,id); UNIQUE(scope,code); CHECK starts_on<ends_on

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; revision_id uuid; campus_id uuid nullable; on_date date; is_teaching_day boolean; label varchar(160)
tables.responsibility: Date exception; campus beats school beats weekly rule. Dates inside year.
tables.constraints: Scoped revision/campus FKs; two NULL/non-NULL partial unique indexes(scope,revision_id,on_date[,campus_id]); immutable

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; calendar_id uuid; number int; teaching_weekdays int[]; published_at timestamptz(3); published_by uuid
tables.responsibility: Immutable full policy snapshot. No generic mutable JSON calendar.
tables.constraints: UNIQUE(scope,calendar_id,number); UNIQUE(scope,calendar_id,id); FK calendar; published_by account; append-only guard

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; year_id uuid; section_id uuid; subject_id uuid; code varchar(40); version int; active boolean
tables.responsibility: One section subject offering in year.
tables.constraints: UNIQUE(scope,year_id,code); UNIQUE(scope,year_id,section_id,subject_id); scoped section/year composite FK and subject FK; UNIQUE(scope,id)

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; code varchar(40); name varchar(160); sort_order int; active boolean; version int
tables.responsibility: School-wide grade catalog. No cross-school shared write.
tables.constraints: UNIQUE(scope,id); UNIQUE(scope,code)

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; year_id uuid; current_revision_id uuid nullable; version int
tables.responsibility: One calendar root per school year; no current pointer until publication.
tables.constraints: UNIQUE(scope,year_id); UNIQUE(scope,id); FK year; deferred current_revision scoped FK added in SQL

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; year_id uuid; grade_id uuid; campus_id uuid nullable; code varchar(40); name varchar(160); active boolean; version int
tables.responsibility: Section in one year/grade/campus, including school-wide no-campus scope.
tables.constraints: Scoped FKs year/grade/campus; UNIQUE(scope,id,year_id); two partial UNIQUE indexes (scope,year_id,grade_id,code) WHERE campus_id IS NULL and (scope,year_id,grade_id,campus_id,code) WHERE NOT NULL

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; code varchar(40); name varchar(160); active boolean; version int
tables.responsibility: School-wide subject catalog.
tables.constraints: UNIQUE(scope,id); UNIQUE(scope,code)

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; employee_id uuid; active boolean; version int
tables.responsibility: Academic teacher profile, not a login identity.
tables.constraints: UNIQUE(scope,employee_id); UNIQUE(scope,id); scoped Employee FK

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; offering_id uuid; teacher_id uuid; valid_from date; valid_to date; version int
tables.responsibility: Primary attendance duty only in Phase 1; one eligible teacher per offering/date.
tables.constraints: Scoped offering/teacher FKs; CHECK from<to; range overlap protected by School guard and app query; index(scope,offering_id,valid_from,valid_to)

tables.fields: id uuid PK; account_id uuid; token_hash char(64); expires_at timestamptz(3); consumed_at timestamptz(3) nullable; revoked_at timestamptz(3) nullable; created_by uuid; operator_id uuid; case_reference varchar(80); reason varchar(500); issued_token_version int
tables.responsibility: One-time 256-bit random opaque activation, hash stored; 24h expiry. Raw token shown once to authorized local operator, never audit/log/URL query.
tables.constraints: UNIQUE(token_hash); FK account and created_by (subject account, with explicit operator provenance); UNIQUE(account_id,id); index(account_id,expires_at)

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; account_id uuid; person_id uuid; verified_at timestamptz(3); verified_by uuid
tables.responsibility: Deliberate verified account-to-person link; People supplies scoped Person reference.
tables.constraints: FK account; FK(organization_id,person_id)→Person; UNIQUE(organization_id,account_id); UNIQUE(organization_id,person_id)

tables.fields: id uuid PK; account_id uuid nullable; kind varchar(40); occurred_at timestamptz(3); request_id uuid; actor_account_id uuid nullable
tables.responsibility: Redacted auth/recovery evidence where a school transaction is not available. No password, raw token or raw identifier for unknown-account attempts.
tables.constraints: FK accounts when present; index(account_id,occurred_at,id); append-only

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; code varchar(40); name varchar(160); status ACTIVE/INACTIVE; version int
tables.responsibility: Optional subordinate site; no campus-level grants in first release.
tables.constraints: FK(scope)→School; UNIQUE(scope,id); UNIQUE(scope,code)

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; account_id uuid; role varchar(40) INSTITUTION_ADMIN; status varchar(20) ACTIVE/REVOKED; version int; granted_at timestamptz(3); granted_by uuid
tables.responsibility: Institution configuration grant; no implicit pupil access.
tables.constraints: FKs organization/account; UNIQUE(organization_id,account_id,role); INDEX(account_id,status,organization_id); role/status/version checks

tables.fields: id uuid PK; name varchar(160); status ACTIVE/SUSPENDED; version int; created_at timestamptz(3); configuration_version int default 1
tables.responsibility: Contractual tenant; no implicit access to all schools.
tables.constraints: CHECK version>0; UNIQUE(id); CHECK configuration_version>0

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; membership_id uuid; code SCHOOL_ADMIN/TEACHER
tables.responsibility: Fixed permission mapping in code; no arbitrary permission JSON.
tables.constraints: FK(scope,membership_id)→membership; UNIQUE(scope,membership_id,code)

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; code varchar(40); name varchar(160); timezone varchar(64); status ACTIVE/SUSPENDED; version int; created_at timestamptz(3); configuration_version int default 1
tables.responsibility: Operational scope and serialization guard. Timezone immutable once sessions exist in Phase 1.
tables.constraints: FK organization; UNIQUE(organization_id,id); UNIQUE(organization_id,code); CHECK configuration_version>0

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; account_id uuid; status PENDING/ACTIVE/SUSPENDED/REVOKED; version int
tables.responsibility: School access root; granting role does not prove teacher eligibility.
tables.constraints: FK school; FK account; UNIQUE(scope,id); UNIQUE(scope,account_id)

tables.fields: id uuid PK; normalized_email varchar(254); password_hash text nullable; status PENDING/ACTIVE/DISABLED; token_version int; failed_attempts int; locked_until timestamptz(3) nullable; version int; created_at timestamptz(3)
tables.responsibility: Globally unique login; no school access without membership. Never return hash or failed-attempt details.
tables.constraints: UNIQUE(normalized_email); counters>=0; index(status,id)

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; session_id uuid; student_id uuid; status PRESENT/ABSENT/LATE/EXCUSED; late_minutes int nullable; current_revision int
tables.responsibility: Current submitted status; one per roster pupil. No blank record stored before submit.
tables.constraints: FK(scope,session_id,student_id)→roster unique; UNIQUE(scope,session_id,student_id); CHECK (status='LATE' AND late_minutes BETWEEN 1 AND 480) OR (status<>'LATE' AND late_minutes IS NULL)

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; session_id uuid; number int; kind SUBMIT/CORRECT/CANCEL; actor_account_id uuid; occurred_at timestamptz(3); reason varchar(500) nullable; changes jsonb
tables.responsibility: Immutable status diff with old/new values and affected student IDs; submit includes complete initial set, cancel includes state transition. No raw private notes field in pilot.
tables.constraints: Scoped session FK; actor FK; UNIQUE(scope,session_id,number); reason required for CORRECT/CANCEL; append-only guard

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; offering_id uuid; school_date date; starts_at timestamptz(3); ends_at timestamptz(3); occurrence_key varchar(80); calendar_revision_id uuid; status SCHEDULED/OPEN/SUBMITTED/CANCELLED; version int; roster_revision char(64) nullable; opened_at timestamptz(3) nullable; submitted_at timestamptz(3) nullable; submitted_by uuid nullable; cancelled_at timestamptz(3) nullable
tables.responsibility: One actual offering occurrence; retains calendar version and scope. School timezone used to validate local date.
tables.constraints: Scoped Offering/CalendarRevision FKs; UNIQUE(scope,offering_id,occurrence_key); UNIQUE(scope,id); CHECK starts<ends; index(scope,school_date,status,starts_at,id)

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; session_id uuid; student_id uuid; enrollment_id uuid; placement_id uuid; display_name_snapshot varchar(210); roll_number_snapshot varchar(30) nullable
tables.responsibility: Frozen at OPEN. Minimal name/roll historical display; access remains current. No mutable roster after OPEN in Phase 1.
tables.constraints: Scoped session/student/enrollment/placement FKs; UNIQUE(scope,session_id,student_id); append-only; session cancellation retains rows

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid nullable; object_key varchar(512); sha256 char(64); mime varchar(100); bytes int; width int; height int; state varchar(20) UPLOADED/SCANNING/APPROVED/REJECTED; created_at timestamptz(3)
tables.responsibility: Published identity, safe asset or verified public host.
tables.constraints: private source; approved derivative reference; size<=2MiB and dims<=2048; scoped retrieval; object_key server assigned

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid nullable; version int; current_revision_id uuid nullable; public_slug varchar(80)
tables.responsibility: Published identity, safe asset or verified public host.
tables.constraints: one institution default WHERE school_id IS NULL; one per branch WHERE school_id IS NOT NULL; separate partial unique indexes; scoped School FK; UNIQUE(public_slug); lowercase slug format check

tables.fields: id uuid PK; profile_id uuid; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid nullable; revision int; state varchar(20) DRAFT/PUBLISHED; display_name varchar(160); branch_label varchar(160) nullable; logo_asset_id uuid nullable; palette varchar(20) forest/indigo/clay; welcome varchar(180); support_email varchar(254); locale varchar(35); published_at timestamptz(3) nullable; published_by uuid nullable
tables.responsibility: Published identity, safe asset or verified public host.
tables.constraints: UNIQUE(profile_id,revision); composite owner FK; published rows immutable; pointer references same profile revision

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid nullable; hostname varchar(253); verification_token_hash char(64); state varchar(20) PENDING/VERIFIED/REVOKED; verified_at timestamptz(3) nullable; brand_profile_id uuid
tables.responsibility: Published identity, safe asset or verified public host.
tables.constraints: UNIQUE(lowercase canonical hostname); ownership challenge; exact verified lookup, no wildcard arbitrary Host trust

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; actor_account_id uuid; year_id uuid; campus_id uuid nullable; namespace varchar(40); schema_version varchar(40); state varchar(40); file_hash char(64); source_bytes bytea nullable; source_expires_at timestamptz(3); preview_revision int; context jsonb; confirmed_at timestamptz(3) nullable; version int; created_at timestamptz(3)
tables.responsibility: Pilot bounded CSV is private DB bytea (max 2 MiB), not public filesystem upload. Context pins dates/reference versions. Raw source expires after 7 days; row outcomes retain minimal identifiers for 30 days, then purge payload by explicit operator retention job.
tables.constraints: Scoped year/campus FKs; account FK; index(scope,state,created_at,id); CHECK octet_length(source_bytes)<=2097152 when nonnull

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; job_id uuid; preview_revision int; row_number int; input_hash char(64); normalized jsonb; decision CREATE/NO_CHANGE/ERROR/CONFLICT; status PENDING/SUCCEEDED/FAILED/SKIPPED; expected_references jsonb; result jsonb nullable; error_code varchar(80) nullable
tables.responsibility: Normalized bounded row, explicit preview outcome and durable safe result. No plaintext credentials. Status changes within one School-guard transaction, so process crash rolls back current row.
tables.constraints: FK(scope,job_id)→ImportJob; UNIQUE(scope,job_id,preview_revision,row_number); index(scope,job_id,status,row_number)

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; namespace varchar(40); external_student_id varchar(100); student_id uuid; created_at timestamptz(3)
tables.responsibility: Stable cross-job source key; no name/email matching.
tables.constraints: UNIQUE(scope,namespace,external_student_id); scoped Student FK; UNIQUE(scope,namespace,student_id) to refuse accidental second source identity

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; person_id uuid; staff_number varchar(40); employed_from date; employed_to date nullable; status ACTIVE/ENDED; version int
tables.responsibility: School institutional profile; links rather than duplicates identity.
tables.constraints: Scoped School FK; FK(organization_id,person_id); UNIQUE(scope,staff_number); UNIQUE(scope,person_id); UNIQUE(scope,id); CHECK end null or from<end

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; first_name varchar(100); last_name varchar(100) default empty; contact_email varchar(254) nullable; version int; created_at timestamptz(3)
tables.responsibility: Canonical name/contact; email contact is not verified login ownership. Minimal pilot PII, no health/document fields.
tables.constraints: FK organization; UNIQUE(organization_id,id); index(organization_id,last_name,id); no email/name uniqueness

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; actor_account_id uuid; module varchar(40); command varchar(80); resource_type varchar(80); resource_id uuid; before jsonb; after jsonb; reason varchar(500) nullable; request_id uuid; occurred_at timestamptz(3)
tables.responsibility: Redacted business changes only; immutable. before/after are small allowlisted diffs, never password/token/CSV bodies.
tables.constraints: FK school scope; actor account FK; index(scope,module,resource_id,occurred_at,id); DB trigger denies UPDATE/DELETE to app role

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; actor_account_id uuid; command varchar(80); key varchar(100); input_hash char(64); response jsonb; created_at timestamptz(3)
tables.responsibility: Only committed safe success response; all fields immutable. Unsuccessful transaction writes no receipt.
tables.constraints: UNIQUE(scope,actor_account_id,command,key); FK school and account; hash/key format checks; immutable trigger

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; module varchar(40); type varchar(100); schema_version int; aggregate_id uuid; aggregate_version int; occurred_at timestamptz(3); payload jsonb; state varchar(20) default PENDING; attempts int default 0; available_at timestamptz(3); delivered_at timestamptz(3) nullable
tables.responsibility: Internal domain fact. Phase 1 only persists; no external delivery is claimed. Future dispatcher uses an explicit lease and receipt migration.
tables.constraints: FK school scope; CHECK schema_version>0, aggregate_version>0, attempts>=0, state in PENDING/DELIVERED/EXHAUSTED; index(state,available_at,id)

tables.fields: id text PK; created_at timestamptz(3) default now
tables.responsibility: id=starter is the idempotently seeded readiness marker. No school data.
tables.constraints: PK(id)

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; actor_account_id uuid; filters jsonb; requested_at timestamptz(3); state GENERATED/FAILED; row_count int; content_hash char(64) nullable; request_id uuid
tables.responsibility: Synchronous bounded export metadata, no public stored CSV. GENERATED means the bytes were prepared, not that browser received them.
tables.constraints: Scoped school/account FKs; index(scope,requested_at,id); no raw exported CSV or credentials

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; student_id uuid; year_id uuid; valid_from date; valid_to date; version int
tables.responsibility: Yearly enrollment root; retained historical ranges.
tables.constraints: UNIQUE(scope,student_id,year_id); UNIQUE(scope,id,year_id); scoped Student/Year FKs; CHECK from<to

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; enrollment_id uuid; year_id uuid; section_id uuid; valid_from date; valid_to date; roll_number varchar(30) nullable
tables.responsibility: Section membership intervals; no duplicated year/student rows per transfer. Roll is display identifier, not a globally unique identity.
tables.constraints: Scoped FK(enrollment_id,year_id) and FK(section_id,year_id); CHECK from<to; index(scope,section_id,valid_from,valid_to,enrollment_id); nonoverlap under School guard, verified concurrency tests

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; person_id uuid; admission_number varchar(40); status ACTIVE/ARCHIVED; version int; created_at timestamptz(3)
tables.responsibility: Institutional student identity; admission number never recycled after archive.
tables.constraints: UNIQUE(scope,id); UNIQUE(scope,admission_number); UNIQUE(scope,person_id); scoped school and organization Person FKs

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; module_id varchar(40); state varchar(20) DISABLED/PROVISIONING/ACTIVE/READ_ONLY/SUSPENDED/RETIRED; version int; enabled_at timestamptz(3) nullable
tables.responsibility: Module contract, activation or configuration evidence.
tables.constraints: UNIQUE(organization_id,school_id,module_id); composite scoped School FK plus Organization FK; index(scope,state,module_id); state/version/enabled_at consistency; active requires entitlement via locked transaction

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid nullable; actor_account_id uuid; expected_revision int; new_revision int; changes jsonb; reason varchar(500); occurred_at timestamptz(3); request_id uuid
tables.responsibility: Append-only institution or branch configuration history with an atomically enlisted revision.
tables.constraints: FKs organization, scoped nullable School and actor account; indexes for institution/branch history and actor; new_revision=expected_revision+1; reason 5–500; append-only

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; module_id varchar(40); state varchar(20) ACTIVE/READ_ONLY/SUSPENDED/RETIRED; starts_at timestamptz(3); ends_at timestamptz(3) nullable; limits jsonb empty object; manifest_version int; version int
tables.responsibility: Module contract, activation or configuration evidence.
tables.constraints: UNIQUE(organization_id,module_id); FK organization; module_id in static catalog; state/date/version checks; limits restricted to empty object until typed quotas ship; contracted operator write only

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; actor_account_id uuid; command varchar(80); key varchar(100); input_hash char(64); response jsonb; created_at timestamptz(3)
tables.responsibility: Idempotent institution command outcomes, scoped to the verified account and tenant.
tables.constraints: FKs organization/actor; UNIQUE(organization_id,actor_account_id,command,key); INDEX(actor_account_id); input_hash SHA-256; immutable

tables.fields: id uuid PK; organization_id uuid; type varchar(100); schema_version int; payload jsonb; occurred_at timestamptz(3); state varchar(20) PENDING/PROCESSING/DELIVERED/FAILED; attempts int default 0; available_at timestamptz(3)
tables.responsibility: Institution-scoped integration events with immutable payload and mutable delivery state.
tables.constraints: FK organization; index(organization_id,state,available_at,id); attempts>=0; schema_version>0; immutable envelope except delivery state

tables.fields: id uuid PK; activation_id uuid; account_id uuid; organization_id uuid; school_id uuid; membership_id uuid; expected_version int
tables.responsibility: Owned immutable relational membership intent snapshot for one activation.
tables.constraints: UNIQUE(activation_id,membership_id); scoped account/membership FK and activation/account FK; CHECK expected_version>0
